summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint config but declares a preinstall hook ("node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, then execFileSync's the adjacent math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation via function WV8StW over a large mixed array n7gIxM, hex-mangled identifiers) with no relation to ESLint configuration. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: the Node-visible setup.mjs is a small loader, and the real payload executes under a separately-fetched runtime so that Node-based scanners never parse it. Installing this package on default settings auto-executes the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine at preinstall time. The @qlik scope and the qlik-oss/dev-tools-js repository reference in package.json target developers expecting Qlik tooling; the behavior is inconsistent with any legitimate release from that scope and is consistent with account compromise or malicious impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
